        loader (ModelManager.ensure_embedding — নতুন method, আগে

        Caller contract: emb = model_manager.ensure_embedding() —
        None পেলে semantic-search feature empty result দেবে (empty
        list/dict), কখনো raise নয়। আগের failure cached — প্রতি call-এ
        আবার ব্যর্থ import/download চেষ্টা করে সময় নষ্ট করে না;
        force=True দিলে আবার চেষ্টা করে।
        """

            return self.instances["embedding"]

        # S05-1: cached-failure short-circuit (আগের failure মনে রাখা —
        # প্রতিটা call নতুন করে fail হওয়া download চালাবে না)।
        if self.errors.get("embedding") and not force:
            return None

        start = time.time()

        try:
            from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer

            emb_cfg = self.config.get("semantic_search", {}) or {}
            model_name = str(
                emb_cfg.get(
                    "embedding_model",
                    "sentence-transformers/paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2",
                )
            )

            print(f"  📥 Loading embedding model: {model_name}")

            model = SentenceTransformer(
                model_name,
                cache_dir=str(MODELS_DIR / "embedding"),
            )

            instance = {
                "model": model,
                "model_name": model_name,
                "device": DEVICE,
            }

            self.instances["embedding"] = instance
            self.load_times["embedding"] = time.time() - start
            self.errors.pop("embedding", None)

            log_event(
                f"Embedding model loaded in "
                f"{self.load_times['embedding']:.1f}s",
                level="INFO",
            )

            print(
                f"  ✅ Embedding model loaded in "
                f"{self.load_times['embedding']:.1f}s"
            )

            return instance

        except ImportError as exc:

            return self._embedding_load_failed(exc)

        except OSError as exc:
            # S05-1: network/disk failure (model download বা cache)।
            return self._embedding_load_failed(exc)

        except Exception as exc:
            # S05-1: unexpected load error — semantic search কখনো

            return self._embedding_load_failed(exc)

name: unescape pipeline: iterative + validate + trailing-strip (S05-2)
new:
# B2 step 1: line-level markdown unescape (before any regex) —
    # MANGABD-007 B2 S05-2 hardening: (1) ITERATIVE unescape-to-stable
    # so double-escaped tags (\\[01.jpg:1\\] → [01.jpg:1]) converge,
    # (2) residual-escape validation WARN (never fail), (3) trailing
    # line-end backslash strip before the tag regex runs.
    lines = raw.splitlines()

    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if "\\[" in line or "\\]" in line:
            # S05-2 (1) iterative unescape: keep unescaping until
            # stable. Each pass strictly shortens the line while any
            # \[ / \] pair remains, so this loop provably terminates.
            while "\\[" in line or "\\]" in line:
                new_line = line.replace("\\[", "[").replace("\\]", "]")
                if new_line == line:
                    break  # stable — no pair survives a full pass
                line = new_line
            lines[i] = line
            stats["unescaped"] += 1

            # S05-2 (2) validate: residual escaped bracket after
            # convergence = pathological input → WARN + continue,
            # never fail (the parse below still reports the line if
            # its tag cannot match).
            if "\\[" in line or "\\]" in line:
                stats["escape_warn"] += 1
                log_event(
                    f"parse_ai_text: residual escaped bracket in "
                    f"line {i + 1}: {line[:80]!r} — continuing (S05-2)",
                    level="WARN",
                )
                print(
                    "  ⚠️ residual escaped bracket after unescape "
                    f"(line {i + 1}) — continuing (S05-2)"
                )

        # S05-2 (3) strip trailing backslashes before parsing —
        # clipboard/AI replies sometimes leave a line-end "\" that
        # would otherwise poison the tag match or the translation.
        if line.endswith("\\"):
            line = line.rstrip("\\")
            lines[i] = line
            stats["trailing_backslash"] += 1
